desc:
WARNING: This game has a lot of flashing visual effects, seizure warning.
---------------------
Play during the weekend will boost the coin earned from progressing waves by 2x
---------------------
Horticulture: The Lawn, a game in The Lawn universe. Some incidents took place hundreds of years ago that caused an infection outbreak. Even after several successful cures, the death still lingers but why…? 
---------------------------- 
Team up with fellow plants from the Horticulture to protect cities from waves of undead. Defeat zombies and grow stronger to protect your garden across the universe.
